answer: A tide of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vine of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. By the jetty of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
